recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7850 unless a future Pharmacy review wants to re-open MedicationStatement-to-v2 mapping policy more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-7850 was Published/Persuasive for Pharmacy and asked to remove the HL7 v2 mapping "RXE-4-Give Amount - Maximum / RXE-5-Give Units" from MedicationStatement.dosage.maxDosePerPeriod because MedicationStatement is not a v2 transaction-domain concept and the mapping was unlikely to be applicable.
initial_application: No commit explicitly naming FHIR-7850 was found in the MedicationStatement source history. The historical Pharmacy v2-mapping batch commit 5bb461af10 removed the v2 mapping row for MedicationStatement.dosage.maxDosePerPeriod from medicationstatement-spreadsheet.sheet.txt, matching the issue request. Later resource refactoring removed the old MedicationStatement-specific maxDosePerPeriod spreadsheet surface entirely.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml defines MedicationStatement.dosage as DosageDetails without a MedicationStatement.dosage.maxDosePerPeriod child or RXE-4/RXE-5 mapping. Corrected Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later directly relevant decision that reintroduced or contradicted this mapping removal.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current core FHIR source already reflects the requested mapping removal. Editing the current source would be redundant or would risk changing unrelated current Dosage mapping semantics.
